meta.description: Search 11 academic literature APIs for papers, preprints, citations, and open-access full text with reproducible provenance. Covers PubMed, PMC (full text), Europe PMC (full-text and preprint search), bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Unpaywall. Provides database selection guidance, identifier cross-referencing, bundled scripts for pagination and parsing, API rate limiting, and auditable output format.

scientific_integrity.detail: Strong emphasis on reproducibility, provenance documentation, explicit reporting of gaps, and treating API responses as untrusted data

practice_boundaries.detail: Clear database selection guide matching use cases to authoritative sources; explicit warnings about API failure modes and silent errors

methodological_ground.detail: Based on documented APIs from authoritative literature databases; includes verification dates and failure-mode documentation

code_usability.detail: Production-ready with 4 bundled Python scripts handling pagination, JATS, arXiv XML, and OpenAlex abstracts; comprehensive reference files

functional_suitability.note: Complete coverage of 11 literature APIs with database selection guide, identifier cross-referencing, bundled scripts, and output format specification

reliability.note: Exceptional error handling guidance: API silent failures documented per database, error recovery workflow, completeness reconciliation, bounded work

performance_context.note: Strong rate limiting guidance, parallelization rules, request bounds (~1000 records, ~50 calls), and bulk data alternatives; SKILL.md 264 lines well-organized

agent_usability.note: Outstanding: 6-step core workflow, database selection tables, common identifier format reference, bundled scripts with exit codes, reference file per API

human_usability.note: Natural triggers (find papers, DOI lookup, citations, full text, preprints), clear use case mapping, explicit scope boundaries

security.note: Excellent: API keys from environment, credential redaction in provenance, untrusted data handling, no shell interpolation of responses, no key echo

maintainability.note: Exceptional structure with 11 reference files (one per database), extensibility guidance for new databases, verification dates, hazard documentation

agent_specific.note: Strong composability across databases; deterministic for same query/time; minor: cross-database deduplication could be more explicit

key_strengths: Exceptional documentation of API failure modes: explicit silent-failure patterns for each database (bodyless 200, error feeds, errCode in 200 body)
Outstanding security practices: API keys from environment, credential redaction in provenance, untrusted data handling, no response interpolation into commands
Comprehensive coverage with 11 APIs, database selection guide, identifier format reference, bundled scripts, and one reference file per database
Strong reproducibility emphasis: provenance requirements, count reconciliation, explicit gap reporting, verification dates for all sources
Production-ready with 4 bundled scripts handling fragile patterns (pagination, JATS, arXiv XML, OpenAlex abstracts) with meaningful exit codes

recommendations.title: Add cross-database deduplication guidance
recommendations.problem: Multi-database queries can return duplicate papers; deduplication strategy not explicitly documented
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on individual database correctness rather than cross-database synthesis
recommendations.fix: Add section 'Cross-Database Deduplication' with DOI-based merge strategy, handling of preprint-publication pairs, and guidance on when to preserve duplicates (e.g., different full-text sources)

recommendations.title: Strengthen credential redaction emphasis for manual curl patterns
recommendations.problem: Credential redaction documented for paginate.py but manual curl examples could leak api_key/email in logs
recommendations.root_cause: Security guidance concentrated in script documentation rather than prominent in core workflow
recommendations.fix: Add callout box in 'Making API Calls' section: 'When logging or sharing curl commands, redact api_key, email, mailto parameters to prevent credential leakage'
